feature: Johnson & Johnson campaign full visual regression
trigger: User screenshot showed the moving order marker overlapping the selected checkpoint summary.
root_causes: The progress trace and diamond marker were positioned at fixed top offsets inside the same vertical band used by checkpoint summary text.
At 1280px the five-column decision grid exceeded the available workspace width because its responsive breakpoint stopped at 1260px.
At 1280px the 930px minimum journey rail clipped the eighth checkpoint from the visible workspace.
The Interview Thesis Brief trace-mini sequence had no wrapping model, causing mobile horizontal overflow.
repairs: Created a dedicated flow lane below all checkpoint text and moved the progress line, dashed trace, and diamond marker into it.
Extended the compact desktop composition through 1320px and reflowed the decision panel at 1280px.
Removed the rail minimum width in the compact desktop range so all eight checkpoints remain in frame.
Added a wrapping, two-column mobile treatment for trace-mini document sequences.
Added a small app wrapper that loads the existing app core and appends versioned visual-QA styles after the journey runtime.

publication.remaining_gate: Verify the corrected runtime, all live routes, reciprocal navigation, motion, employer identity, and PDF downloads from the GitHub Pages repository path.
